team_notes.title: Panthers club — Oct 5
team_notes.bottom_line: Panthers 32, Lions 26 (SNF). McMillan 14 catches / 192 / two TDs, Hubbard 20 for 122 and two scores, Young 329 with no picks; late fourth-down stop seals it. 2–2 into the bye. Pass.
key_points: FINAL: W 32–26 vs DET, Bank of America Stadium — the first Sunday Night Football game in Charlotte in 11 years (ESPN box; panthers.com). Tied 16–16 at half; CAR scored 16 of the next 19 (McMillan 10-yard TD, Hubbard 2-yard TD, Fitzgerald 33-yard FG) to lead 32–19 before Goff hit LaPorta for 8 with 3:38 left. Rookie CB Will Lee III and S Lathan Ransom stopped Detroit's final fourth down short (panthers.com); DET 1-for-3 on fourth down (ESPN box).

Young 29/41, 329, 2 TD, 0 INT, sacked 3x (ESPN box). McMillan 14/192/2 on 16 targets — 32- and 10-yard TDs; nine catches for 147 in the first half, a franchise record for receptions in a half (panthers.com). Next: Metchie 3/37, Waller 3/36 (ESPN box).

Usage: Hubbard 20 carries / 122 / 2 TD (15 and 2 yards; long 32); CAR ran 28 times for 127 (4.5 ypc) and held the ball 33:15, zero turnovers (ESPN box). Hubbard passed Christian McCaffrey for third on the club's all-time rushing list among running backs (panthers.com). Fitzgerald 2-of-2 on FGs (47, 33) but missed two extra points (ESPN box).

Defense, without both starting corners (Horn and Mike Jackson to IR Wednesday; Akayleb Evans and Lee started — panthers.com): Goff 32/52 for 412, 1 TD, 0 INT; DET held to 15 rushes for 46 and 2-for-4 in the red zone; DET K Jake Bates 4-of-4 on FGs (ESPN box). Evans led with 11 tackles (ESPN box).

Injuries: rookie RT Monroe Freeling (knee) left in the third quarter and did not return — Stone Forsythe replaced him; OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) went to the injury tent in the fourth and did not return (panthers.com). Already out: LG Damien Lewis (Corey Bullock started) and WR Jalen Coker, inactive; WR Xavier Legette placed on IR Saturday, out at least four weeks (panthers.com). No further statuses published in these sources.
W5: BYE (ESPN W5 slate — teams on bye: KC, CAR). Bye note only.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Bye-week word on Freeling's knee and Phillips' hamstring; Coker and Lewis returns; corner depth with Horn and Jackson on IR. McMillan's target share (16 of 41) as Coker comes back.
team_notes.sot_flag: Score FINAL ESPN (status Final, 32–26). Freeling / Phillips are in-game exits per panthers.com — no diagnosis beyond knee / hamstring, no return dates, no IR invented. Legette IR per panthers.com. ESPN recap/AP story not yet posted at pull (~11:55 p.m. ET); box from ESPN summary API.
